description: A county assessor's tax lot, cached as a READ-ONLY REFERENCE. Nothing on this site links out from it — not an Item, an Asset, a Location or a Parcel — and nothing on the operating books reads it: it is the county's statement about a piece of ground, kept so a Lot Line Adjustment can name the lots it changes. Only taxlot_lookup and taxlot_refresh write it; the Desk cannot.

fields.description: The assessor's map and tax lot number in the county's own spelling ('2N 13E 12 C 100'). IT IS ALSO THE DOCNAME. Written only by taxlot_lookup and taxlot_refresh.
fields.label: Map / Tax Lot

fields.description: Which county GIS service this lot came from, as erpnext_mcp.api.gis.COUNTIES names it ('wasco').
fields.label: County

fields.description: The taxpayer the county names. A reference, not a title search — the deed decides who owns the ground.
fields.label: Owner of Record

fields.description: The county's own calculated acreage off its GIS layer. Not a surveyed figure.
fields.label: Acres (county GIS)

fields.description: County GIS: fetched from the county's parcel layer. Manual: seeded by hand from a tax statement or a county printout while the county server was unavailable — refresh it once the server answers.
fields.label: Source

fields.description: The lot's polygon as GeoJSON in WGS84 degrees, as the county published it.
fields.label: Geometry (GeoJSON)

fields.description: Every attribute the county returned for this lot, untranslated — the columns this form does not name are still here.
fields.label: Raw County Attributes

name: County Tax Lot
